name: email-love
description: Official Email Love plugins for Claude: build export-ready emails in Figma from your design system

plugins.name: emaillove-figma-builder
plugins.description: Build export-ready marketing and lifecycle emails inside your Figma file, with a guided brief, visual component picker, and inspiration from 500,000+ real brand emails. Two paths: instance your Email Love design system, or start from scratch with AI Import when you do not have one yet

plugins.name: emaillove-migration-audit
plugins.description: Read-only audit of an existing Figma design system for Email Love migration: a deduplicated module inventory with a verdict per module (live-text, editable-image, hybrid, not emailable), scale-factor detection, brand foundations, effort estimate, and a hand-off to the converter

plugins.name: emaillove-eds-converter
plugins.description: Convert an audited legacy Figma design system into a working Email Love design system: foundations, then modules in batches with design review between batches. Works from the module inventory and scale factor in an emaillove-migration-audit report
